Subject: Renewal coverage validation & billing cadence — BrightByte Q4 readiness

Hi Kimberly & Marissa,

We're starting our Q4 renewal planning for BrightByte and want to lock down a few items so Finance can finalize the coverage plan: 

1) Confirm committed ARR for the upcoming renewal window (the contract shows $1.2M annualized) and whether that remains the committed figure.
2) Confirm billing cadence and any expected partial billing split in Q1 2027 (we have an internal audit asking if there will be a one-time pro-rate or monthly invoice).
3) Any outstanding approvals or PO timing that might push the renewal beyond Jan 15, 2027.

If we can get a short response today (or a 30-min sync), that would help our quarter-end close. I'm looping Procurement on the CC in case they need any worksheets.

Thanks,
Lisa Torres
Director, Finance Ops
BrightByte

Subject: Re: Renewal coverage validation & billing cadence — BrightByte Q4 readiness

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Quick summary / asks from our side so finance can reconcile: 

- Committed ARR: Our records show a committed renewal ARR of $1,200,000 (same as your contract extract). I'll open a verification with Billing, but can you confirm whether any add-on purchases post-9/30/2026 should be included in that number?

- Billing cadence: We typically do net-30 invoicing unless you request a pro-rated upfront invoice. From a renewal ops perspective, we can accommodate a one-time pro-rate for a Feb-Jul billing split, but we need a PO or signed SOW before we lock in that cadence in our system. Does Procurement have a preferred template?

- Approvals / PO timeline: If Procurement can target signed PO submission by 2026-12-10 we can ensure no gap in coverage and the Jan 15 renewal date will remain clean. If the PO slips past 12/20 we may need to set a short-term extension (simple amendment) to avoid lapses.

Action items I propose: 
- Kimberly: confirm AR number with Billing and attach usage evidence (I will attach usage file shortly).
- Ben: please validate the billing line item and confirm whether anything on the account is flagged for adjustment.
- Marissa: can you confirm CS health signals / any adoption dips that might impact renewal probability?
- Lisa / Procurement: please share PO timing and whether you want a single upfront invoice or monthly invoices for 2027.

I've attached a mutual action plan template (BrightByte_MutualActionPlan.xlsx) and the last quarter usage summary (BrightByte_Usage_Q3.pdf) for your review. If it helps, I can set a 30-min call Monday to go through the plan and surface any gating items.

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park

- Committed ARR: $1,200,000 (pending Ben's final billing line check).
- Requested PO cutoff for no-gap renewal: 2026-12-10 (target).
- Billing options: (A) single upfront pro-rate invoice for Jan 2027 or (B) standard monthly invoices starting Feb 2027. Please confirm preference.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- By 2026-11-16: Redwood to deliver usage reconciliation and list of any billing adjustments (Ben).
- By 2026-11-20: BrightByte to confirm preferred billing cadence and provide expected PO submission date (Lisa / Procurement).
- By 2026-12-10: Signed PO or amendment in HubSpot (deal DB-4579-BB) to lock coverage.

Link: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4579
Doc: https://app.redwood.com/docs/BB-renewal-evidence

If Procurement confirms timeline by Monday, I'll open the PO hold and schedule the renewal notice to go live.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

—Kim
